INTEGRATING THE LOGICAL SPECIFICATION MODEL WITH THE EXISTING DETECTORS

This is a research inference/serving component. No backend API, DB migration,
administrator approval interface or alert transport is implemented by this bundle.

Offline design
1. Prepare one metadata-only JSON snapshot: physical schema, complete occurrence
   identities, relationships, source definitions, capture assumptions, records and
   an analysis purpose. Provide verified constraints as evidence, not as guesses.
   Observed frequencies alone do not establish a protocol prohibition.
2. cli.py recommend returns actual local-model proposals and all attempts. The
   typed compiler checks executable bindings and measures each admitted plan.
   discover / discover-roots can explore more source populations without giving
   the model a private expected rule list. No call guarantees exhaustive discovery.
3. Review candidate meaning, scope, normal exceptions and evidence. A source-valid
   plan can still be semantically wrong. Freeze the approved calculation/evidence
   version. Exported recommendations are disabled until external adoption.

The logical model is ONE joint logical-plan adapter. It is additional to the
preserved numerical Feature/Rule adapters. Code projects a proposed logical plan
into a nullable-Boolean variable and a rule referencing that exact variable.
This is not a second independently learned Feature-LLM discovery call.

After a completed transaction arrives
Prepare related T/P/M metadata using the same physical schema and source meanings.
The project assumption is post-completion batch arrival; actual ingestion times
are not available. Give every projected field explicitly, using JSON null for an
unknown value. Exclude Body/payload and evaluation-only labels/arm/pair mappings.

The same new logs have two parallel code paths:
  A. Frozen logical rules: cli.py serve or library-serve. --bulk uses indexed CPU
     execution and never forwards those full rows to an LLM.
  B. Existing frozen numerical feature transformation, numerical SR and ML models.
     Keep the trained feature order, preprocessing, units and thresholds unchanged.
     New Boolean variables from A are not automatically inserted into a 42-feature
     ML input. Doing so requires a separately approved input-contract change and
     retraining/validation, which this logical bundle does not perform.

Keep the detailed source-row provenance. Aggregate P/M findings to transaction
identity only through the verified occurrence relationships; do not group solely
by a reusable PROCESS_ID. Unknown or missing identity is not evidence of normality.
The included replay-esb-export and replay-esb-status CPU commands demonstrate
binding for their exact reviewed project T/P/M projections. Arbitrary new CSV
schemas still need an explicit, reviewed input adapter; these commands do not
infer a new customer schema or business meaning automatically.

Results and references
serve result.json contains:
  decision: warning | nonwarning | unavailable
  rules: original proposal IDs, roles, nullable row values and support rows
  linked_feature_contracts: feature_id, definition_sha256, calculation, grain,
      source/capture/runtime policies and pending review state
  linked_rule_recommendations: condition.feature_id and
      condition.feature_definition_sha256, op=is_true, role, evidence, enabled=false
  linked_feature_values: the same feature_id/feature_definition_sha256, source
      row/key/version and measured nullable Boolean value
  evidence_requests, pending_evidence_count, coverage_status

Exported roles are HR_candidate and observed_SR_candidate. The latter is a factual
review diagnostic, not a confirmed unrecovered incident or numeric threshold SR.
The preserved numerical SR pipeline remains separate. HR requires a verified
contract/constraint; unverified meaning generates an evidence request or no rule.

Combine the approved checks and ML results using three-valued OR:
  Any warning -> warning.
  All required participating methods evaluated and nonwarning -> nonwarning.
  Otherwise -> unavailable.
A no-rule/evidence-request pack is incomplete coverage, not a nonwarning detector.
Do not turn an exception, failed conversion or missing observation into zero/false.
Preserve rule IDs, source evidence and ML scores alongside the combined decision.

An explanation is specific to the represented predicate. For example, a dependency
link may change while all frozen numerical ML inputs remain equal. A logical rule
can describe that relation difference; this does not imply that ML in general
cannot learn relationships, or that the transaction had no other ML warning.

Schema, definition, evidence or runtime policy changes require explicit re-review.
Version changes can intentionally change linked feature IDs. Keep old measurements
and old models with their own contracts instead of silently mixing their vectors.
